appraisal_events.evidence: il resta néanmoins muet et se retira au bout de quelques secondes, d'un air frétillant... je compris que M. de Vaugoubert avait oublié comment je m'appelais... avait fait consister la présentation en une simple pantomime.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator portrays M. de Vaugoubert as socially inept, forgetting the narrator's name and covering the lapse with an empty, silent pantomime instead of a proper introduction, comically undercutting his diplomatic dignity.

appraisal_events.evidence: Mme de Vaugoubert, c'était un homme... Des traces d'opprobre, d'ennui, d'indignation, ternissaient le visage régulier de Mme de Vaugoubert... elle alla jusqu'à m'empoigner le bras pour que je la conduisisse boire un verre d'orangeade.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator subjects Mme de Vaugoubert to an extended mock-naturalist analysis of her masculinization, framing her as a pathetic, almost botanical specimen marked by shame and futile longing toward the narrator.

status_effects.explanation: His forgetfulness and mute, evasive pantomime make him appear absurd and diminished in the narrator's account.
The narrator's clinical, reductive natural-history portrait of her masculinization clearly diminishes her within the passage.
She is shown marked by shame and unfulfilled longing, seizing the narrator's arm out of a desperate, one-sided attraction, leaving her in a weakened emotional position.
